notes.title: Game update plan - Imperial City test chapter
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,
We are going to update the major version of the Imperial City by mid-March
Some of the updates are as follows:
1. Add a new 2.5D display mode
2. Take all hand-painted female characters to increase the sense of substitution
3. Add a new story line
4. Add new NPCS and related quest stories
5. Add new ways to play the game
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The new version will be placed within the existing DLC at no additional cost

Note: After the new version is launched, the price of DLC will be increased, and players who have not purchased DLC are advised to buy it first.

notes.title: Game update plan - Imperial City test
notes.notes:
*** Next version update notice
Players, the ancient wind is spreading new story and new characters we expect to meet you in mid-March.
The updates are delivered directly into the current DLC, and players only need to purchase the Spring Festival DLC
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
In the next version, we will take a 2.5D perspective to tell the story of the protagonist entering Beijing to catch the exam, which will give the player a new experience.

We will adjust the price of DLC after the version update. If you have not bought DLC yet, we recommend you to buy it in advance.

Players who need patches please add our exclusive game group number which has been placed on the mall homepage.

notes.title: Game update plan announcement - Spring Festival chapter
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, first of all thank you for your support for our game.

In the following January, we will add a new game section.

* Characters will be added such as white tiger Qian son mother
* In terms of scene, we will build a colorful and more characteristic Heavenly Palace map for everyone to explore and play
* In terms of task flow, we have introduced tedious repetitive combat and boring collection such as gold hunting, adding new ways to complete tasks. Make the game more playable.
* In terms of experience, we added more animations and a "playability" theme.
* In addition, we have added a variety of customs to help people find the taste of the New Year.


Finally, I hope you all support, thank you for your attention ~~

notes.title: December 4, 2023 Meimo version early release announcement
Meimo version plan update time and related announcements
notes.notes:
The new version of 'Succubus' is scheduled to be released on December 5, 2023.
The Meimo version will have a complete main storyline and new gameplay. We have added new large map scenes for players to play, and at the same time, the fishing system will also be unlocked in the Meimo version for everyone to play, further enriching the gameplay.
In terms of combat, we will add a new boss mechanism that is different from traditional monsters, and increase player attack methods to increase combat fun. After a boss battle, there is a chance to drop rare fashion for everyone to experience.
